Every measured claim reproduces by driving the master in chromium at 1440x960 across all seven states. In state=empty and state=error, `main h1,h2,h3,h4` returns [] and the single `main section` has aria-labelledby=null; the titles are literally `

No work recorded yet

` (lately.html:795) and `

Tasks did not answer

` (lately.html:814). In all seven states `[role=status],[aria-live],[role=alert]` returns zero elements. The loading line is `

Loading this reading.

` (lately.html:806) with no role, while plan.html:697 (§07) specifies for that state 'A polite role="status" line' — so this is the surface failing its own written spec, not a reviewer's preference imported from outside. The other five states are correct by contrast, which is what makes this a real gap rather than a house style: full/partial/quiet/first-run all ship `
` with a real `

`, so the two terminal states are the only places the established pattern is dropped. The consequence is stated correctly and is if anything understated: heading navigation in empty and error lands on `h1 Home` and stops, and loading is no better than the seat says — its three skeleton headings sit inside `aria-hidden="true"` on `.sk-wrap`, so nothing in `main` is exposed to AT there either. Neither gate covers this: interaction-check.mjs asserts only that no `.sr` line is buried under aria-hidden (line 166) and that the refusal heading matches m1's rank (line 407); it never counts headings inside main or looks for a live region, so this is not a restatement of proven ground. audit.mjs keys type-ramp checks off `data-type`, which the fix preserves, and the fix introduces no colour, no weight and no architectural change, so no non-negotiable is touched. Severity 'defect' is the right class and I am not correcting it: nothing here asserts an untruth (misleading) and the copy is still reachable in reading order, so the product does what it says (not blocking) — it is structurally wrong and passable, which is defect. The proposed fix is right in direction and its markup is correct in detail (ids, `.t-sect` retained, `data-type` retained), but two things in it need tightening before it lands, given below.
sharpenedFix:
Keep the heading promotion exactly as proposed — `
` with `

No work recorded yet

`, and `mError` / 'Tasks did not answer' for the error state — but add `margin: 0` to the promoted headings rather than relying on a block-margin reset from a different finding landing first (see breaks: measured, the swap is NOT visually neutral on today's source). Change `role="status"` on the loading line exactly as proposed: `

Loading this reading.

` — that one matches plan.html §07 verbatim and needs no correction. Scope the alert more tightly than proposed: putting `role="alert"` on the error card's `.center` makes an implicitly atomic, assertive region out of a block that also contains the 'Try again' button and the 'Last good reading' timestamp, so the whole card — button label included — is read on any change inside it. Wrap only the title and the explanation instead, e.g. `
` around the `h2#mError` and its `p.t-body`, leaving the button and the timestamp outside the live region; the retry control stays reachable by heading and by tab, and a future retry-in-progress state cannot re-fire an assertive announcement of the entire card. Optional, and cheap while the file is open: the loading state has the same heading gap the seat found in the other two, because its only headings are inside `aria-hidden="true"` on `.sk-wrap` — the new `role="status"` line closes the announcement half but a heading-navigating reader still lands on nothing after 'Home'.
breaks: The claim that 'nothing changes visually' is false against today's source and must not be taken on trust — there is no global heading/paragraph block-margin reset in lately.html (the only reset is `* { box-sizing: border-box }` at line 109 and `body { margin: 0 }` at line 114), so UA block margins are live throughout. Measured in chromium on the empty state: today's `p.t-sect` carries margin-block 26px (1em of 26px); the promoted `h2.t-sect` carries 21.58px (0.83em). Swapping them shrinks the card from 369.64px to 360.80px tall and lifts the title 5px, the body copy 9px and the 'Open Tasks' button 9px. The same shift lands on the error card. That is why the promoted headings need an explicit `margin: 0` — or the block-margin reset that finding depends on must land in the same round, not a later one. After it lands, re-measure: re-shoot light and dark empty and error at 1440x960 and 390x844 and diff against the current frames (the shots are the only place the shift would be caught); re-run audit.mjs, which reads `data-type` for the type ramp and leading and should be unaffected but will re-verify contrast on the moved elements; and re-run interaction-check.mjs, whose 'no screen-reader line is buried under aria-hidden' check now has a `role="status"` node in loading to consider, and whose declared-key render check must still pass for all seven states at both variants. Also confirm the loading cleanup at lately.html:957 — `root.querySelectorAll('.sk-wrap .sr')` removal — still leaves the new `role="status"` line intact, since that line is a sibling of `.sk-wrap`, not a descendant. Finally, add a gate assertion so this cannot regress silently: for every state, `main h1,h2,h3,h4` must be non-empty and every `main section` must carry `aria-labelledby` resolving to a present id.
